text:
Which statement describes a saturated solution?
A
It is a solution that contains the maximum concentration of solute.
B
It is a solution that contains the maximum amount of solvent.
C
It is a hydrocarbon that contains both double and single bonds.
D
It is a hydrocarbon that contains only single bonds.

options.label: A
options.text: It is a solution that contains the maximum concentration of solute.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a solution that contains the maximum amount of solvent.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a hydrocarbon that contains both double and single bonds.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a hydrocarbon that contains only single bonds.
